verdict.rationale: AgentMail exposes a hosted MCP server that lets any compatible AI agent (e.g. Claude) operate inboxes/messages/threads via natural-language tool calls, and offers a no-code CLI, which supports AI-native operation indirectly through a connected client rather than a built-in NL interface. Missing for 10: no first-party conversational/NL interface within AgentMail itself, no evidence of natural-language command parsing in the CLI (docs only say 'without writing code'), and no independent hands-on confirmation of MCP-driven natural-language workflows.
